assign.outcome:
**Columns now stay put, and three fit on a 1280 screen.** Each column is about a third of the row wide (34cqi). Opening a new column never resizes one that is already open.

![after: three columns on screen at 1280](/framework/ai/2026-09-24/core-columns/shots/nav-after-1280.png)

- **Navigation doesn't jump.** On the columns docs demo at 1280, the third click used to slide the row 375px sideways and push the first column half off screen. Now it slides 0px and all three columns stay in view. Column widths never change on a click, before or after. Before: [nav-before-1280](/framework/ai/2026-09-24/core-columns/shots/nav-before-1280.png).
- **Fill gives the space back.** A `fill` column with a child open under it now drops to the normal width, so the child opens at its own width. The alternative was to keep letting it grow.
- **Column head and nested Doc were already right.** The column head already pads on the column's own tokens. A nested Doc has drawn as a plain section since 2026-08-27. Both checked on screen and written down.
- **Nothing else moved.** Eight pages nobody on this task built were shot at 1280, 1920 and 3440 before and after: /framework/, /framework/ai/, /framework/ai2/, the JSONL module doc, /layouts/, the Reader, /notes/ and /notes/auth/. None changed, apart from live counts on the AI pages. [The diff report](/framework/ai/2026-09-24/core-columns/shots/diff/report.md). The Reader still centres at 3440.
- **Two old page errors fixed along the way.** /notes/ had a typo in a thumbnail's class call, and the /imagine/paging/ lab showed a blank page. [The lab again](/framework/ai/2026-09-24/core-columns/shots/paging-fixed-1920.png). The main site now loads with 0 console errors.
- Docs: [core/Page columns](/framework/core/Page/doc/columns.md).

Left: /imagine/design/navigation/ returns 404, even though its parent page says every old address still answers. The same study lives at /web/nav/doc/study/. The worktree folder is merged, but it would not delete because a file is locked; `git worktree prune` clears it later.
